verdict.rationale: Stripe's own docs show in-person payment acceptance on compatible readers, and explicitly cover contactless payments via Tap to Pay on iPhone and Android with the Terminal SDK. However, the pack never explicitly names chip (EMV) insertion or Apple Pay / Google Pay wallet acceptance, so only one of the story's three payment methods is directly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of chip/EMV card acceptance, explicit documentation of Apple Pay / Google Pay mobile-wallet acceptance, independent hands-on corroboration.
